purpose: Specific official FSSAI/FoSCoS regulatory classification and named identity routes for standardized products and special categories. This file contains category/identity links, not complete compliance determinations.
prohibitions: Never equate FCS codes or recipe numbers with operative FSSR standard clauses.
Never pass full compliance based solely on this category mapping.
For FPC 18, do not automatically apply this route to a food already standardized in FPC 01-14.
Do not assume FSSAI 2025 Ayurveda Aahara recipe list is exhaustive after June 2026 Part 2.
Never treat FCS category mapping as a standalone FSSR product standard.
Never treat Chapter 3 additive identity/purity as permission for use in a finished food.
For dried edible seeds, observe the 15 March 2024 FSSAI interim licensing order until a newer official standard is independently verified.

official_sources.type: Indian sweets and snacks direction, Annexures I-II
Ayurveda Aahara Category A order 25 July 2025
2026 Part 2 update requires separate recipe ingestion

routes.official_source_part: Annexure I product descriptors and Annexure II applicable additive category table
checks_required: Product must not already be standardized within FoSCoS categories 01-14
Confirm appropriate additive limits for mapped additive categories; multiple categories are not blanket permissions
Base-ingredient Appendix B microbiology; contaminants and aflatoxin/DON/NOTS based on inputs as applicable
Product-specific labelling and claims

r14_source_review.scope: Official classification/licensing/recipe/ingredient route and explicit limitations; not a standalone finished-product legal approval.
r14_source_review.verified_finding: FSSAI 19 July 2021 direction verified: FPC 18 was introduced for licensing Indian sweets/snacks where standards were unavailable; it is not for products already standardized/mapped in FPC 01–14.
r14_source_review.product_context_required: Confirm the product truly belongs in FPC 18 and is not already standardized; formulation/base ingredients; Annexure II additive mapping; base-product microbiology; contaminants; labelling/claims.
r14_source_review.microbiology_route: Direction requires microbiology according to Appendix B for the base product used (e.g. milk-based sweets follow milk-based microbiology).
r14_source_review.additive_route: Use only the Annexure II mapped additive categories plus applicable GMP provisions; multiple mappings are not blanket permissions.

fpc18_controls.contaminants_route: Foods not specified / actual applicable ingredients as required by current CTR

checks_required: Verify full ingredient recipe and processing details against the signed official recipe attachment
Evaluate all applicable Ayurveda Aahara Regulations 2022 and 2026 Part-2 update
Category A eligibility, prohibited ingredients, food safety, labelling and schedule compliance

r14_source_review.scope: Official classification/licensing/recipe/ingredient route and explicit limitations; not a standalone finished-product legal approval.
r14_source_review.verified_finding: Exact recipe identity is listed in FSSAI/FoSCoS Category A. FSSAI may update the Category A list over time; Part-2 recipes were published 19 June 2026.
r14_source_review.product_context_required: Match exact authoritative recipe ingredients/process and form; verify Ayurveda Aahara category eligibility, Schedule C additives, Schedule D safety/microbiology, packaging, specific labelling and claims restrictions.
r14_source_review.microbiology_route: Apply Ayurveda Aahara Schedule D criteria according to product/use form; no unrelated Appendix B plan is substituted.
r14_source_review.additive_route: Only Schedule C/additionally applicable permitted route; recipe listing does not waive additive restrictions.
